title: 水庫抽泥疏浚~Reservoir dredging
focus: 串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程~Connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management
summary: 本課以串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程為主線，先用測深網格與挖方與乾質量與孔隙界定水力與構造條件，再將管徑流速與沉積、沉澱面積與表面負荷連結到復測容積與淨成效。以指定泥漿均質近似與乾質量帳示意，實際泵送、沉降及環境限制需現地試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management through Bathymetric grid and excavation volume and Dry mass and porosity, then connects Pipe diameter velocity and deposition and Settling area and surface loading to Resurveyed capacity and net benefit. Specified homogeneous-slurry and dry-mass examples illustrate bookkeeping; pumping settling and environmental limits require field testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。以指定泥漿均質近似與乾質量帳示意，實際泵送、沉降及環境限制需現地試驗。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Specified homogeneous-slurry and dry-mass examples illustrate bookkeeping; pumping settling and environmental limits require field testing. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查測深網格與挖方：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3；再獨立檢查乾質量與孔隙：inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t。敏感度：泥漿流量0.25m3/s不變，固體體積濃度由0.10增至0.15時，固體產率由90增至135m3/h，增加50%；但混合密度與管損同時改變，不能假定泵站功率維持不變。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以指定泥漿均質近似與乾質量帳示意，實際泵送、沉降及環境限制需現地試驗。 將以乾燥樣品核對泥餅固含率並與運輸地磅質量對帳作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Bathymetric grid and excavation volume: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3. Independently examine Dry mass and porosity: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t. Sensitivity: at0.25m3/s slurry flow, raising solids volume concentration from0.10 to0.15 increases solids production from90 to135m3/h, or50 percent. Mixture density and losses also change, so pumping power cannot be assumed constant. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Specified homogeneous-slurry and dry-mass examples illustrate bookkeeping; pumping settling and environmental limits require field testing. Use the following independent check: Verify cake solids by drying samples and reconcile weighbridge records. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 測深網格與挖方~Bathymetric grid and excavation volume
units.title: 測深網格與挖方~Bathymetric grid and excavation volume
units.mechanism: 疏浚量以現況與目標底面的差積分，需使用一致水平座標及高程基準。網格平均深度乘面積適用明定分區，陡坡與邊界需更細解析；測量潮位或庫水位補償錯誤可能使整區出現假挖方，應先處理基準再計量。 驗證時應以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折，並辨識以下失效情境：整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Dredging volume integrates the difference between existing and target beds in a common coordinate and elevation system. Cell-average thickness works for defined zones, while slopes and edges require finer resolution. Incorrect water-level correction can create false volume across the whole area, so establish datums first. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: surveyArea=12000 m2; meanRequiredCut=1.8 m; inSituCutVolume=12000*1.8=21600 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

Diagnose it by the following check: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. units.practice: 交接時以以獨立水準控制核對測深基準並加密邊坡與斷面轉折作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對整區高程偏差會系統性放大或縮小計價挖方，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check bathymetric datum against independent leveling and refine slopes and section breaks. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An area-wide elevation bias systematically changes measured excavation volume. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 乾質量與孔隙~Dry mass and porosity
units.title: 乾質量與孔隙~Dry mass and porosity
units.mechanism: 原位沉積物含有孔隙水，原位體積、固體體積與排出泥漿體積不能混用。乾密度乘原位體積可估乾砂質量，但需代表性的分層樣本；含水量和壓密隨深度變化，單一表層密度不能代表整個開挖厚度。 驗證時應分層量測含水量與乾密度並核對採樣代表性，並辨識以下失效情境：把飽和總密度當乾密度會高估實際移除固體。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~In-situ deposits contain pore water, so bed volume, solid volume and pumped slurry volume differ. Dry bulk density converts in-situ volume to dry mass only with representative stratified samples. Water content and consolidation vary with depth; one surface density cannot represent the full excavation thickness. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure water content and dry bulk density by layer and check sample representativeness. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using saturated bulk density as dry density overstates removed solids. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: inSituVolume=1000 m3; dryBulkDensity=1300 kg/m3; drySolidsMass=1000*1300/1000=1300 t. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 泥漿密度與濃度~Slurry density and concentration
units.title: 泥漿密度與濃度~Slurry density and concentration
units.mechanism: 混合密度可由水與顆粒密度按體積分率加權，但質量濃度和體積濃度不同。均勻泥漿近似不代表粗粒不會在管底形成高濃度層；密度計需適當校正，並與重量法採樣比對以確認輸砂產率。 驗證時應以重量法樣品比對密度計並檢查管線是否分層流動，並辨識以下失效情境：將質量百分比誤當體積百分比會算錯泥漿密度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Mixture density is volume-weighted from water and grain density, but mass fraction is different from volume fraction. A homogeneous approximation does not exclude near-bed concentration of coarse particles in a pipe. Calibrate the density meter and compare gravimetric samples before calculating production. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare density readings with gravimetric samples and inspect possible stratified pipe flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Confusing mass percentage with volume percentage miscalculates slurry density. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; solidsVolumeFraction=0.15; rhoSlurry=0.85*1000+0.15*2650=1247.5 kg/m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: rhoWater=1000 kg/m3; rhoSolid=2650 kg/m3; solidsVolumeFraction=0.15; rhoSlurry=0.85*1000+0.15*2650=1247.5 kg/m3. units.anchor: 固體產率與有效工時~Solids production and effective time
units.title: 固體產率與有效工時~Solids production and effective time
units.mechanism: 泵送總流量包含大量水，真正移除固體的產率需乘固體體積濃度。瞬時高產率不等於班次總量，定位、停機及管線維護降低有效工時；應以時間積分的濃度流量乘積計算，避免把各自平均值任意相乘。 驗證時應同步記錄流量濃度與有效抽泥時段並核對總乾質量，並辨識以下失效情境：以名牌泵量乘整班時間會高估實際抽除量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Pumped flow includes water, so solid production requires solids fraction. A high instantaneous rate does not equal shift output because positioning, downtime and maintenance reduce productive time. Integrate concentration times discharge over time instead of automatically multiplying unrelated averages from different periods. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record flow, concentration and productive periods together and reconcile total dry mass. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Nameplate flow multiplied by the whole shift overstates actual removal. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 管徑流速與沉積~Pipe diameter velocity and deposition
units.title: 管徑流速與沉積~Pipe diameter velocity and deposition
units.mechanism: 輸送管流速須與泥砂沉降及磨耗共同考量，過低易沉積，過高則增加能耗與磨損。連續方程只給平均速度，不提供沉積臨界值；臨界輸送需依粒徑、濃度與管徑試驗，不能套用一個通用最低速度。 驗證時應比較流速管壓與停機後沉積跡象並核對泥砂級配，並辨識以下失效情境：低速停留會形成砂床並使再次啟動阻力增加。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Pipeline speed must balance deposition, energy and wear. Continuity provides mean speed but not a critical deposition threshold. The required transport condition depends on size, concentration and diameter and needs suitable testing; one universal minimum velocity cannot cover every slurry. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare velocity and pipe pressure with postshutdown deposits and sediment gradation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Low-speed residence creates a bed that raises restart resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 泵送水頭與功率~Pumping head and power
units.title: 泵送水頭與功率~Pumping head and power

units.anchor: 沉澱面積與表面負荷~Settling area and surface loading
units.title: 沉澱面積與表面負荷~Settling area and surface loading
units.mechanism: 沉澱池以表面負荷比較水流通過速度與顆粒沉速，理想離散沉降假設忽略短流、絮凝與再懸浮。面積估算不能取代停留時間分布與出水試驗；水流入口擾動及污泥堆積會降低實際有效區域。 驗證時應以示蹤或流場觀測檢查短流並比較進出水粒徑濃度，並辨識以下失效情境：入口噴流直達出口會使名義面積無法充分利用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Surface loading compares throughput with settling speed under ideal discrete-settling assumptions. Area estimation does not replace residence-time and effluent tests, and inlet disturbances or sludge accumulation reduce the effective settling region. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check short-circuiting by tracer or flow observation and compare inlet-outlet sediment sizes and concentrations. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An inlet jet reaching the outlet bypasses much of the nominal settling area. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 脫水質量與處置~Dewatering mass and handling
units.title: 脫水質量與處置~Dewatering mass and handling

units.title: 回流水濃度與通量~Return-water concentration and flux
units.mechanism: 回流水可能攜帶細粒返回庫區或下游，濃度與總水量共同決定返回質量。單次低濃度不代表事件負荷低，長時間排水仍可能累積顯著通量；應依核准監測點量測背景與排放，分辨自然混濁和作業增量。 驗證時應以同步流量與濃度積分計算回流負荷並比較上游背景，並辨識以下失效情境：只報最低瞬時濃度會掩蓋總排放質量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Return water can carry fines back to the reservoir or downstream. A low spot concentration does not establish a low event load because sustained flow accumulates mass; monitor background and discharge at approved locations to distinguish operational increments. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate paired flow and concentration for return load and compare upstream background. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reporting the lowest instantaneous concentration hides the total returned mass. units.anchor: 復測容積與淨成效~Resurveyed capacity and net benefit
units.title: 復測容積與淨成效~Resurveyed capacity and net benefit
units.mechanism: 疏浚完成後需用同基準復測確認有效容量增加，挖出量不一定全部轉為可用庫容，邊坡回淤與施工外擴都會影響結果。淨增量須扣除同期沉積並列不確定度；長期成效還取決於後續入砂率與維護策略。 驗證時應以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量，並辨識以下失效情境：只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Postdredging surveys on the same datum establish useful capacity gain. Account for concurrent sedimentation and uncertainty; long-term benefit also depends on future sediment input and maintenance rather than one completion survey.
